scope: P4U1/P12U1/P4U2 batch four live tags; P4U1 three target Verify and SLH128f full Sign. No h20 jobs.

review.conclusion: No functional issue found in formatter prefetch/SEND overlap, simultaneous prepare/return, or retiring tag refill.

invariants.reason: SELECT or accepted SEND prepares controls and next endpoint address on the same edge. First BUILD consumes the asynchronous parity-bank data after the registered address has updated.
Preparing a tag clears need_block. An in-flight compression cannot become a candidate until its return sets need_block, so the old-state scheduler cannot prepare the returning tag on that edge.
Complete tags have no pending block. Retire clears state before final allocation writes; an accepted request for the retiring tag wins and is scheduled from the next edge.
Response refresh returns held_tag to default zero after draining; full SLH Sign passed the previous FORS root/capture failure boundary.

limitations: P12U1 batch unit test exercises four simultaneously live tags, not all twelve contexts.
Full Sign in this local subset is SLH128f only; other algorithms Sign and larger P12 context occupancy are handled by the parent matrix.
